0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Ciuille needs someone to rescue her from a culinary mishap.

24.original: Slay blue deer does and obtain their meat.

25.original: Set the doe meat as bait at the designated location.

26.original: Lie in wait for the scarred caracal and slay it when it appears.

27.original: Return the doe meat and caracal blood to Ciuille.

48.original: Ah, a savior appears in my most desperate moment! Who? Why, that would be you, of course.

49.original: You see, I became so absorbed in my work, I failed to notice I lacked the provisions to apply the final touches. I would procure them myself, but I cannot very well leave the food to cool.

50.original: That is why I must ask you for help. Please, would you gather meat and blood and return them to me? You have my word you will not go unrewarded.

51.original: Splendid! You have no idea how much your aid means to me.

52.original: The task is a simple one, but requires several steps. In order to obtain the fresh blood I require, you must draw out a scarred caracal with the meat of its prey.

53.original: They are known to hunt blue deer does, which can be found near Bowrest. Embark on a hunt of your own, and place two pieces of the doe meat as bait near trees around the camp.

54.original: The rest is painless. Slay any caracals that come seeking an easy meal, and bring me their blood. This task is more vital than you can know, but I trust you to get it done.

55.original: Use the doe meat to draw out the caracals, and bring their blood back to me. A simple enough task for one of your capabilities.

56.original: How goes the hunt? Do you have the ingredients?

57.original: I knew you were up to the challenge! Gods bless the day I met an ally of Ronka!

58.original: This meal is no ordinary one. I am preparing it for my companions who were wounded while patrolling the Greatwood.

59.original: It is meant to help the body mend, and for that I needed the lifeblood and flesh of a beast most savage. It is a wonder I overlooked such ingredients in the first place...

60.original: Nonetheless, I thank you for your help. We shall toast in your honor!
